Talia (Finance): FYI Aurora.ai reported a burst/overage charge stacked on top of their reserved commit for 2026-06-12 04:10-04:22 UTC. They say it's the same work billed twice. Can billing verify?
Jon (Billing): Looking at INV-2026-0991. There's reserved commit + burst lines both referencing nodepool aurora-prod-5 in overlapping minutes.
Marta (CS): Aurora had a brief failover during that window. We expected traffic to remain in their reserved pool after failover. They already pinged support.
Alex (Ops): Pulling metering export and router traces. If the exporter emitted identical meter_ids to both buckets because of a retry, that would explain the duplicate.
billing-sentry: Auto-check: INV-2026-0991 shows overlapping meter_id values between reserved_bucket and burst_bucket for aurora-prod-5. Flagged for manual audit.
Talia (Finance): Please attach metering CSV for aurora-prod-5 04:00-04:30 UTC and give a quick overcharge estimate.
Alex (Ops): Short excerpt from export: ```
2026-06-12T04:15:07Z aurora-prod-5 reserved_bucket tokens=10,240 meter_id=mi-a1b2
2026-06-12T04:15:07Z aurora-prod-5 burst_bucket tokens=10,240 meter_id=mi-a1b2
```
Marta (CS): meter_id match confirms double-count. Customer finance already escalated. We should offer immediate relief.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. What's the estimated dollar impact? Talia?
Talia (Finance): Duplicated tokens ≈10,240 -> ~$81. Propose provisional credit $100 (covers tax/rounding) and offer a 7-day waived burst allowance as a goodwill gesture. Also propose a small 1% SLA credit on next month committed invoice.
Jon (Billing): I can create provisional credit memo. I'll tag it provisional_credit and hold final reconciliation until Ops completes full audit and we confirm vendor correlation. Need Nora's approval to apply.
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved for provisional credit $100 + 7-day waiver and 1% next-month SLA credit. I'll review the outgoing customer message.
Alex (Ops): Root cause: exporter used attach_id as dedupe key; retry reused attach_id on the cloud side, producing duplicate meter samples. Patch merged and deployed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/2705 deployed 2026-06-13 02:10 UTC. Full audit CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-06/aurora-dup-2498765432.csv
billing-sentry: Ticket created: BILL-3845 - "Aurora.ai duplicate metering - provisional credit issued" assigned to Jon.
Talia (Finance): One more item 1 can Ops confirm whether DigitalOcean (provider) observed duplicate attach events? If so we should coordinate a joint postmortem.
Alex (Ops): Reached out to cloud-metering@digitalocean.com; they acknowledged duplicate attach traces for the VM due to an attach retry. They're investigating and will share logs.
Jon (Billing): Created credit memo CM-2026-PROV-632 and applied provisional credit to INV-2026-0991 on 2026-06-20. billing_note=duplicate_attach_retry_export.
Marta (CS): I'll prepare a plain-language customer email: "We've applied a provisional credit of $100 and are completing a detailed reconciliation; we'll follow up within 7 business days with final numbers and next steps." Nora will review before sending.
Nora (AcctMgr): Sounds good. Hold public-facing details minimal and focus on remediation + timeline.
Talia (Finance): Thanks all. Marking this thread waiting-on-provider and will close when final reconciliation posted to BILL-3845.
Jon (Billing): Noted  provisional credit applied and ticket updated. Will post final adj after Ops audit complete.
Talia (Finance): Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
